title: SharedSAE: a unified sparse dictionary across u-net blocks and denoising time for diffusion models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13997v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Concept representations in diffusion models drift across network depth and denoising time, yet existing sparse autoencoders offer only per-block or per-timestep dictionaries, leaving no single feature dictionary for localization and intervention in the network. We present Shared Sparse Autoencoder (SharedSAE), which learns one sparse dictionary shared across four U-Net attention blocks and all 50 denoising steps of SDXL 1.0. A block-specific low-rank input adapter aligns the residual distribution of each block before the shared encoder, and a temporal conditioning module with a shared timestep branch and a block-timestep correction branch absorbs temporal non-stationarity. Despite spanning both axes, Shared SAE preserves a coherent dictionary structure. Built on the shared dictionary, localized feature suppression reduces the number of NudeNet-positive generations in the I2P detector-positive subset from 139 to 1. Tracing sparse featur

translated_title: SharedSAE：一种面向扩散模型、跨越U-Net模块与去噪时间的统一稀疏字典
translated_abstract: 扩散模型中的概念表征会随网络深度和去噪时间发生漂移，然而现有的稀疏自编码器仅能提供针对单一模块或单一时间步的字典，无法为网络中的定位与干预提供一个统一的特征字典。我们提出了共享稀疏自编码器，它在SDXL 1.0的四个U-Net注意力模块和全部50个去噪步骤上学习一个共享的稀疏字典。模块特定的低秩输入适配器在共享编码器之前对齐每个模块的残差分布，而由共享时间步分支和模块-时间步校正分支组成的时间条件模块则吸收时间维度上的非平稳性。尽管同时跨越两个维度，SharedSAE仍保持了连贯一致的字典结构。基于该共享字典，局部化特征抑制将I2P检测器阳性子集中NudeNet阳性生成结果的数量从139降至1。对稀疏特征的追踪（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 提出SharedSAE，通过低秩输入适配器和时间条件模块，在SDXL 1.0的四个U-Net注意力模块与全部50个去噪步骤间学习统一的稀疏字典，实现扩散模型中概念特征的跨模块、跨时间定位与干预，可将不安全图像生成从139例降至1例。
en_tdlr: SharedSAE learns a single sparse dictionary shared across U-Net attention blocks and all denoising timesteps of SDXL 1.0, using low-rank adapters and temporal conditioning to enable unified localization and intervention of concept features in diffusion models.
